title: Expand the remedy for interoperable silos
requirements:
- State that local extensions must keep exchanged data conformant to the national minimum model
- Add cross-references from 2.2.2 and Figure 2.2 to the 3.6.2 analysis of uncoordinated extension
- Include national implementation guides, profiles, terminology versions and conformance testing in the remedy
- Identify a governed national interoperability-specification publication process
- Add a progressive pathway adopting international/regional models first
